hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Gravel pack packer
function: The packer above the interval that carries the screen assembly, seals the annulus, and receives the completion seal assembly afterwards.

tabs.overview: Set hydraulically from the service tool; its bore takes the crossover during the pack and the production seals after.
tabs.engineering: Rated for the pack pressure and the production differential.
tabs.safety: Set and tested before the pack is pumped.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sand control techniques (S42), ISO 17824 for screens (S47), API RP 19C for gravel testing (S12 if held), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
